title: Window Washing Work Order
subtitle: Residential Window Washing: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Window Washing Work Order covers window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish. The window service coordinator records Residential Window Washing authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Window Washing Work Order keeps Residential Window Washing exceptions visible until the window service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Window Washing Work Order at residence interior, exterior elevation, ladder area, roof access, and protected room. Document window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish identity before Residential Window Washing begins. Compare window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish findings with stated Residential Window Washing criteria; route unresolved Residential Window Washing issues to exterior cleaning supervisor. For Window Washing Work Order, confirm requirements for Residential Window Washing. Ask exterior cleaning supervisor to review Residential Window Washing conditions beyond the window service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Customer, provider, and approved-work evidence
sections.guidance: For Residential Window Washing, identify responsible parties, residence interior, exterior elevation, ladder area, roof access, and protected room, and the linked window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish source.

blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Window Washing when safe access, damaged glazing, product compatibility, privacy, or opening security remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Window Washing proof and route unresolved window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish scope to window service coordinator.
